tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud & Java Backend | Headless & PWA APIs
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris). Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of integrations between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, and agile teamwork. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

cover_en.subject: Application: Developer - Salesforce B2C Commerce (all genders)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my interest in joining adesso SE as a Developer in Karlsruhe. With over five years of professional backend e-commerce experience building and maintaining enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in Java, Spring, and RESTful web services.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management.

bullets.label: APIs and Headless Commerce
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for custom data flows.

bullets.label: Integrations and Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Cloud and Platform Operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows while supporting production troubleshooting and maintenance.

cover_en.gap: While my professional expertise is focused on SAP Commerce Cloud rather than Salesforce B2C Commerce, my robust foundation in enterprise e-commerce architectures, Java, and RESTful integrations allows me to adapt quickly, and I am very keen to learn Salesforce B2C Commerce.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe and hold a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and I will be available to start from 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my background with you in an interview.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce backend expertise in Java, Spring, and RESTful integrations to adesso SE in Karlsruhe. I am drawn to your collaborative environment, strong technical standards, and the opportunity to build robust digital solutions within an agile team.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce, Java, and REST API experience from Rockwell Automation and Shell to build scalable solutions at adesso SE.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an experienced e-commerce developer with 5+ years building enterprise platforms using Java, Spring, and REST APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Based in Karlsruhe and available from Dec 2026, I would love to connect regarding the Developer role at adesso SE.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Developer - Salesforce B2C Commerce (all genders) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Developer - Salesforce B2C Commerce position at adesso SE. With over five years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms using Java, Spring, and REST APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-equipped to contribute effectively to your team.

I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and am available to start on 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
